mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.intro: Confirm it is you: use your passkey (Face ID / Touch ID) or a code.
mfa.use-passkey: Sign in with passkey (Face ID / Touch ID)
mfa.passkey-cancelled: The passkey was not used. Try again or use a code.
mfa.failed: That did not work. Check the code and try again.
mfa.setup-required: Set up two-step sign-in in your profile (Security).

security.title: Security · two-step sign-in
security.status-on: On: after the password, sign-in asks for your passkey or a code.
security.status-off: Off: add a passkey (and the authenticator app as a fallback) to turn it on.
security.passkeys-help: Saved in iCloud Keychain, so it works on your iPhone and Mac. On a computer without Touch ID, the browser shows a QR code to scan with your iPhone.
security.confirm-remove: Remove it? Keep at least one way to sign in.
security.totp-help: Google Authenticator or another app: a 6-digit code when the passkey is not at hand.
security.totp-qr-alt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.code-wrong: Wrong code. Check the time on your phone and try again.
security.recovery-help: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. Unused codes: {{count}}.
security.devices-help: Browsers remembered for 30 days skip the second step.
security.failed: That did not work. Security changes are allowed within 15 minutes of signing in: sign out, sign in again and retry.
security.passkey-exists: This device already has a passkey for this account (iCloud Keychain shares it between your iPhone and Mac), so no second one is needed. Sign in with it.
